errorCodes.meaning: No slot the caller may read has this `mnemonic`. Returned alike for a slot that does not exist and one the caller does not own.

The submitted `domain` is not a known hosting domain on this consumer, or — for a domain series — not one the caller is scoped to. See [category conventions](../../../_shared/0.1/CONVENTIONS.md#2-unknown-domain-error).

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

points.description: One point per bucket in the window, oldest first, including buckets with no activity.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

points.description: One point per bucket in the window, oldest first, including buckets with no activity.

domain.description: With `mnemonic`, disambiguates it per the category conventions. Without it, selects the sum over every slot on that domain. Absent with `mnemonic` absent means the server-wide series, which only an administrator may read.

mnemonic.description: One slot's series. Absent means a domain's series when `domain` is present, else the server-wide series.

range.description: The window ending now. The consumer chooses the bucket width and reports it as `bucketSeconds`.
